package rulefixtures

import (
	"net"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_lazy_loading_eager_connect_to_all_backends: Layer: Lazy loading. Flag services connecting to every optional backend at startup instead of lazy initialization.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var (
	dbConn    net.Conn
	cacheConn net.Conn
	s3Client  *http.Client
)

func scenario554Positive() error {
	// All backends are connected at startup — even those that are
	// optional or may never be used during this process lifetime.
	// This adds unnecessary latency to startup and wastes resources.
	var err error
	dbConn, err = net.Dial("tcp", "db.internal:5432")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cacheConn, err = net.Dial("tcp", "redis.internal:6379")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s3Client = &http.Client{}
	return nil
}
